RoA_GLOBAL_HEROES_WIL_002.en: Wilhelm is a veteran captain that defended Stormwind alongside with Meryn. After exodus to Lordaeron he serves Anduin Lothar as his personal bodyguard.
RoA_GLOBAL_HEROES_WIL_002.tr: Wilhelm é um capitão veterano que defendeu Ventrobravo junto a Meryn. Apos a evacuação para Lordaeron, ele serve de guarda-costas pessoal de Anduin Lothar.

RoA_GLOBAL_HEROES_WIL_020.en: Unit plays dead, in order to restore health and come back to fight. Ability has a <A61V,Cool1> second cooldown.
